narratives.Description: bug(release): adoption-blocker punch list must not block a tag
narratives.Overview:
The release census treats `adoption-blocker` as a tag block. Fifty-five open issues wear that label. They are the punch list, and a cut must be able to ship while they stay open.

`blocks-release-tag` remains the only label that stops a tag. Do not close the punch-list issues. Do not add a ships-past hatch. Do not derive `adoption-blocker` from a title.
